race.comment: MASHEAN (10) improving mare who was three weeks between runs when he faded late to run fourth over 1000m at the Sunshine Coast. Blinkers go on from the rails draw and will take catching. HAYLEY'S ROCKET (7) jumped in trip and failed to let down in the straight when she folded up to run a dismal last as fav over 1200m at this circuit. Back to her right trip and stays in the mix. MONACO FLYER (12) justified the short price with an all-the-way win over 1106m at this track in weaker company. Saves his best for the home track and not to be overlooked. EVER SO READY (9) resumed from a spell last start and did well to finish third at Warwick over 800m, 1.5 lengths from the winner. Should appreciate the extra distance second-up and the weight drop. Worth consideration.
